title: Without See Financial Data a split reprices the moved parts by the rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders when work order 1 was made, and on tier A for work orders now.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a category A part at a cost of $10.00 (sold at $15.00, Default).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Split the part onto a new work order.
  3. Sign out.
  4. Sign in as an Admin with 'See Financial Data'.
  5. Open the new work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The split is allowed and a new work order is made with the part.

Step 3:

  • The sign-in page shows.

Step 4:

  • The Admin is signed in.

Step 5:

  • On the new work order the part sells at $12.00 ($10.00 × 1.20 = $12.00): priced again by tier A, customer A's current tier.
  • It shows no Manual icon.
